anya (PM): quick thought — can we add reusable query macros to saved queries? e.g. {team}, {model_alias}, {route_group}. teams could save one filter and it adapts per-route/model. reduces duplication and helps rollouts.
jess (Eng-Console): sounds useful. how do you imagine UX? autocomplete? resolved-preview?
sam (DevEx): autocomplete + a little chip that shows the resolved value for the current view. also need permission rules: {team} should only expand to teams you belong to.
matt (Eng-Platform): backend note: macros mean we either resolve at save-time (per-user snapshot) or at render-time. render-time is more flexible but complicates caching + telemetry tagging. also need to think about index-friendly expansion so queries stay fast.
anya (PM): prefer render-time so saved queries stay generic. but we should offer an option to snapshot expansions for e.g. audit/QA.
oberon (Eng-Metrics): if we resolve at render-time we must attach "resolved_macro" metadata to telemetry events so cost/rollout analytics use the right dimension. otherwise reports will be inconsistent.
jess (Eng-Console): +1 on tagging. UX idea: a "preview" button on saved-query that shows a sample of routes/models and estimated token cost / quota impact before applying. would be huge for Dedicated customers. :eyes:
matt (Eng-Platform): preview is doable but expensive if we run the full planner. propose a lightweight preview that samples telemetry and estimates sproc costs, with a disclaimer. rate-limit preview to once per minute per user or require canary role.
sam (DevEx): for the preview UX can we show a diff: resolved values, sample top-5 affected routes, and an estimated monthly token delta? keep it compact.
oberon (Eng-Metrics): implementation detail: preview endpoint should accept a `time_window` param (e.g. last_7d) and a `sampling_rate` flag. example payload: ```POST /api/v1/saved_queries/preview { "query": "model:{model_alias} status:200", "macros": {"model_alias":"{model_alias}"}, "time_window":"7d", "sampling_rate":0.05 }``` We'll return {"estimated_tokens":"123k","top_routes":["/v1/generate","/v1/chat"],"resolved_macros":{"model_alias":"redwood-7b"}}
matt (Eng-Platform): agrees, and adds: preview response should include a `cache_key` so we can reuse expensive previews for a short TTL. also enforce a max_sample_size server-side to avoid runaway jobs.
jess (Eng-Console): auth question — who can create macros? anyone can use common macros but creating org-scoped macros (e.g. {billing_center}) should be limited to admins. we need UI for macro registry.
anya (PM): next steps: matt/oberon to spec the preview API & telemetry tags, sam/jess to mock the UI chips + preview panel, I'll add an entry to roadmap and flag for next sprint. can we have an RFC doc by EOD Friday? :thumbsup:
matt (Eng-Platform): on it. I'll drop a draft in #eng-platform and ping you.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: console-service v2.14.1 -> prod at 2024-04-12T18:00:00Z
anya (PM): noted. thanks everyone.
